name: AK16D-CO - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, CO, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), Carbon Monoxide Detection, AQI Display
highlights: Carbon Monoxide Added — An electrochemical CO cell brings the count to nine measured parameters. CO is colourless and odourless, which is the whole reason it has to be instrumented rather than noticed.

Where This Configuration Belongs — Kitchens with gas hobs, homes with a wood stove or unvented heater, attached garages, boiler rooms, and any rented property where the landlord carries the duty of care.
AQI Index Alongside Nine Readings — The composite figure for quick judgement, every underlying value for the detail.
Positioned as a Monitor — Continuous sited monitoring with an on-screen alert. Where local regulations require a listed CO alarm, this sits alongside one rather than replacing it.
2000 mAh, Six Hours, 30 Per Carton — Same enclosure and packing as every other AK16.

specs.Readings: CO2, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO, TVOC, temperature, humidity, AQI
